caption: The drawing depicts a muscular human arm, bent at the elbow and holding a wooden-handled mallet or hammer. The arm is covered with a draped, loose-fitting fabric, which appears to be brownish-olive in color with some yellowish highlights and folds suggesting texture and volume. The hand is gripping the handle, and the skin on the visible forearm shows pronounced anatomical features such as veins and tendons. The mallet has a cylindrical, greyish head with shading that suggests a metallic or stone material, and its handle is brown. The background is plain and light beige, with no additional elements or details. The composition focuses exclusively on the arm, hand, and mallet, rendered in a realistic style.
title: Gold Beater's Sign
